description: Cambridge Building Footprint Lines is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors City of Cambridge Geographic Information System (CGIS). This map data layer represents the outlines of all buildings, larger than 100 square feet, for the City of Cambridge, Massachusetts. Coverage includes Institutional (public buildings, including schools, libraries, churches, government centers, hospitals, major government institutions); Municipal (City owned buildings); Subway headhouses (outline of subway headhouse). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational non-commercial use only. The City of Cambridge makes no claims, no representations, and no warranties, express or implied, concerning. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
